title: MapleStory Classic Warrior Leveling Guide
author: Nia Meow
summary: A level 10-30 Warrior route covering STR and DEX allocation, Power Strike and Slash Blast order, weapon multipliers, equipment choices, and second-job preparation.

sections.title: Core build
items: Use STR as the primary stat and keep only the DEX needed for the route.
Power Strike and Slash Blast form the shared first-job foundation.

sections.title: Weapons and armor
items: Compare sword, axe, spear, polearm, and blunt-weapon multipliers before investing.
Meet armor requirements without overcommitting secondary stats.

sections.title: Second job
items: The shared first-job build can lead into Fighter, Page, or Spearman.
Prepare the preferred weapon family before the level 30 choice.

notes: Structured MPStorys reading edition verified in Chrome on 2026-07-27.
steps: Upgrade weapons and armor at efficient breakpoints.
Choose Fighter, Page, or Spearman at level 30.
